explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/499: for a real n×n doubly stochastic M = (a_ij), is there σ ∈ S_n with ∏_i a_{iσ(i)} ≥ n^{−n}? True (Marcus–Minc). The Lean statement: ∀ n, ∀ M ∈ Mathlib's doublyStochastic ℝ (Fin n) (nonnegative entries, row and column sums 1), ∃ σ : Perm (Fin n) with (n:ℝ)^(−n) ≤ ∏_i M i (σ i). The n = 0 case is the trivial 1 ≤ 1. Positive 'yes' form per the question convention. Faithful.
